communications.subject: Idaho Public Records Act Request: Flock Organization & Network Audit
communications.communication:
To Whom It May Concern:

Pursuant to the Idaho Public Records Act, I hereby request the following records:

1. Data Access and Network Sharing (a) The Flock "Organization Audit" report showing all searches made within this agency's Flock system from the date of installation through the date of this request. (b) The Flock "Network Audit" report showing all searches of this agency's Flock data by any outside agency from the date of installation through the date of this request. (c) A list of all agencies currently authorized to access this agency's Flock data, including any federal agencies. Please provide these records in their original electronic, machine-readable format (CSV or spreadsheet).

The requested documents will be made available to the general public, and this request is not being made for commercial purposes.

In the event that there are fees, I would be grateful if you would inform me of the total charges in advance of fulfilling my request. I would prefer the request filled electronically, by e-mail attachment if available or CD-ROM if not.

Thank you in advance for your anticipated cooperation in this matter. I look forward to receiving your response to this request within 3 business days, as the statute requires.

Sincerely,

Trever Flahaut

title: 19 Rawson Rd, Hanover — c.21E, Hazardous Waste and Industrial Wastewater Records (Smokeeter Sales & Svc / Air Cleaning Services)

communications.subject: Massachusetts Public Records Law Request: 19 Rawson Rd, Hanover — c.21E, Hazardous Waste and Industrial Wastewater Records (Smokeeter Sales & Svc / Air Cleaning Services)
communications.communication:
To Whom It May Concern:

Pursuant to the Massachusetts Public Records Law, M.G.L. c. 66, §10, I am requesting the following records from the Massachusetts Department of Environmental Protection (MassDEP) — Southeast Regional Office (SERO), Bureau of Waste Site Cleanup concerning the property located at 19 Rawson Rd, Hanover, MA 02339, associated with Smokeeter Sales & Svc and Air Cleaning Services LLC (EPA/RCRA ID MAR000595850):
•	All chapter 21E release files and Release Tracking Numbers (RTNs) for this address
•	Hazardous waste generator and inspection records for Air Cleaning Services LLC (MAR000595850) and any prior hazardous waste handler operating under the "Smokeeter" name
•	Industrial wastewater and floor-drain records
•	Spill records
Please search by property address, including responsive historical records under the Smokeeter name and any other former operator names.

I also request that, if appropriate, fees be waived as we believe this request is in the public interest, as suggested but not stipulated by the recommendations of the Massachusetts Supervisor of Public Records.

Electronic copies provided through this MuckRock request or a secure download link are preferred. Where available, please provide searchable PDFs or other accessible electronic formats.

In the event that there are fees, I would be grateful if you would inform me of the total charges in advance of fulfilling my request.

Thank you in advance for your anticipated cooperation in this matter. I look forward to receiving your response to this request within 10 business days, as the statute requires.

Sincerely,

Vlad Gaylun
